title: lazyreview config
description: lazyreview's config file, config.yml. docs/Config.md lists every setting and its default.

dataHome.description: Where lazyreview keeps reviews, clones and the running app's files.

port.description: The port the app listens on, on this machine only.

command.description: The Claude Code command that answers a question about a line.

model.description: The model that answers. Empty: Claude Code's own default.

editor.description: The command that opens a comment, a question or an edit. Empty: VISUAL, then EDITOR, then vi, as git chooses.

accounts.description: The GitHub accounts whose open pull requests the home screen lists. Each is read by its own gh token. A review asked of a team counts as asked of the account, for pull requests opened on or after `since`.

lineNumbers.description: How the terminal app's diff numbers its lines: absolute, each line its own number; relative, the cursor's line its own number and every other line its distance from it, as Vim's number and relativenumber do; or none.

theme.description: The terminal app's colours, for a dark terminal and a light one. Each is #rrggbb or a terminal colour number from 0 to 255.

keybinding.description: Keys as lazygit writes them: a letter, or <space>, <enter>, <esc>, <tab>, <up>, <down>, <left>, <right>, <c-x> for Ctrl-x. A sequence is its keys in a row, such as gg, ]c or <space>v. A list gives an action more than one key. <disabled> removes a key.
